nav.overview_sub: Today's tasks and the weekly summary
nav.remote_hint_online: You can see all the data; publishing, collecting, site checks and syncing run on your computer ({name}), and AI tasks go to the assistant there (follow them under Assistant on the left).
nav.company_sub: Positioning, verified facts and use cases
nav.opportunities_sub: Research demand, keywords and page opportunities
nav.metrics_sub: Visit, signup, activation and payment events
nav.website-content_sub: Manage topics, plans, drafts and live content by destination page.
nav.social-content_sub: Manage topics, plans, content and publishing by platform and account.

channels.not_enabled_desc: The account is added, but publishing and data collection for this platform aren't set up. Let the assistant set it up; then you can sign in here, publish from Content center and see data in Social media.

reports.running_desc: It'll show up here when done, usually in a few minutes; click "View chat" to watch each step.

leads.reply_hint: Fill in the parts marked [ ]. After sending, set the status to "Contacted".
leads.reply_empty: No draft yet. Hand it to the assistant to write one in the buyer's language; it shows up here.
leads.reply_req_hint: The assistant follows these every time it drafts a reply. Change your signature, pricing wording, tone or length here — the next draft follows the new version.
leads.title: Inquiries
leads.desc: Form submissions from your sites, checked for whether they're real inquiries and how serious, with the landing page and campaign they came from. New submissions arrive in real time.
leads.m_real_hint: Excluding sales pitches, spam and tests
leads.m_high_hint: Specific products and quantities, asking for quotes or samples
leads.no_site: No site channels yet. Add a site under Sites & accounts and its form submissions will sync here.
leads.offline: Open the back office from Annulo to sync inquiries.
leads.empty: No form submissions yet. Once someone submits a contact or quote form on your site, it shows up here right away. If the site has no form, ask the assistant to add a quote form.
leads.all_spam: Only real inquiries are shown, and every submission so far was judged a pitch, spam or test. Switch to All to see them.
leads.open_page: Open the page it was submitted from ↗

content.desc: Collect inspiration, plan topics, create content and publish to websites and social accounts.
content.writing_desc: It'll show up under Articles when done, usually in a few minutes; click "View chat" to watch each step.
content.revising_desc: This page refreshes when it's done, usually in a minute or two; click "View chat" to see what it changed.

geo.no_site: No site channels yet. Add one under Sites & accounts to check whether AI answers cite you.
geo.no_table: The three AI search tables (geo_questions / geo_runs / geo_results) aren't ready yet. Annulo creates them from the declarations in tables/; refresh in a moment.
geo.no_questions_desc: AI search checks use questions real buyers would ask. Generate a batch from your positioning and site content, then pick the ones to keep.
geo.gen_desc: Hands off to the assistant on the right: it reads your company profile and site content, writes questions buyers who don’t know you yet would ask AI (no company name), and saves them to the question list for the next check. Follow along in the chat on the right.
geo.topics_req_hint: The assistant follows this every time it suggests topics (the same one the content center uses).
geo.topic_one_desc: Hands off to the assistant on the right: turns “{q}” into a topic in the content center, ready to write an article so AI cites you. Follow along in the chat on the right.
geo.topics_desc: Hands off to the assistant on the right: turns the {n} questions where AI doesn’t cite your site into topics in the content center, ready to write articles from. Follow along in the chat on the right.
geo.brand_dialog_desc: No AI involved: fills your brand name, main category and first two products from “Company & products” into questions buyers commonly ask (what the company does, its products, MOQ and certifications, factory or trader, official website…). The language follows your key markets. Below are the ones not in your question list yet; tick the ones to add.
geo.brand_empty_desc: Generate the questions buyers ask once they know you (what the company does, which products, MOQ and certifications, the website…) from the company name, brand terms and products in "Company & products", in the language of your target markets.
geo.sum_no_rec: No recommendation questions yet, so there's no way to tell whether AI recommends you to buyers who don't know you yet.
geo.desc2: When buyers already know you and compare options in AI, is what each AI says right? When buyers don’t know you yet, who does AI recommend? Checks run on this computer and can ask several AIs at once (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Doubao…), automatically once a week.
geo.pick_engine_first: No AI is turned on yet: in check settings, turn on the ones your buyers use (mostly ChatGPT overseas; Doubao or DeepSeek in China).
geo.s1_desc2: Once buyers know your company, products or website, they ask AI to research and compare. Each row is a question and each column an AI: "New" means you haven’t read this answer yet; open a row to read the answers side by side. If something looks off (wrong, why it says so, how to fix it), ask the assistant under that answer.
geo.eng_desc2: Every AI you turn on is asked in each check, all at the same time. Web versions ask in your own Chrome (signed in as you, needs the Annulo browser extension) and show what buyers really see; API versions use a model you set up in Annulo.

social.writing_desc: It'll show up under Review when done, usually in a minute or two; click "View chat" to watch each step.
social.hub_desc: Account status, followers and engagement. Edit, review and publish content in Content center.

formhook.title: Receive form inquiries
formhook.desc: Your WordPress form plugin posts each submission to this address, so it lands in Inquiries right away and is checked automatically. Just paste the address into the plugin's Webhook settings — it already carries the key.
formhook.key: Key (only if a tool asks for it separately: header {header}, or hidden field {field})
formhook.howto: How to set it up in each plugin
formhook.elementor: Elementor Forms: edit the form → Actions After Submit → add "Webhook" with the URL above.
formhook.wpforms: WPForms: Settings → Webhooks (needs the Webhooks addon) → add, URL above, request format JSON.
formhook.cf7: Contact Form 7: install "CF7 to Webhook" and put the URL above in the form's Webhook tab.
formhook.other: Zapier, Typeform and others: POST to the URL above, JSON or form encoded.

wizard.title: Start your product growth assistant
wizard.import_hint: Select a website. The assistant reads its product facts and use cases, then saves them after your review.
wizard.manual: Enter product facts and users manually

onboarding.new_site_reparse: A new website is selected. The next step prepares product facts and users; existing data stays until you confirm.
onboarding.reparse_review: Review the product positioning, features and user scenarios found on the selected site. Confirm to save them under Product and users.
onboarding.extracting: Reading product positioning, features and user scenarios from the selected site.
onboarding.extracting_wait: Reading the selected website and preparing product facts and users. Review opens when extraction finishes.
onboarding.extract_hint: Review product facts and users. Leave unsupported information blank.

workspace.website_desc: Manage topics, plans, drafts and live content by destination page.
workspace.social_desc: Manage topics, plans, content and publishing by platform and account.
workspace.suggest_desc: Use product facts to prepare topics for this workspace and save them in its content management.
workspace.performance_note: One chart per platform version, each on its own scale (platforms differ by orders of magnitude). Numbers are the latest collected totals; collection runs once a day.

dash.title: Data overview
dash.partial_note: Some accounts only just started daily collection; for them these are totals for posts published in this period.
dash.no_social: No social accounts yet. Connect one to see daily views, engagement and followers here.
dash.no_site: No Creght website yet. Add one to see daily visits here.
